description: Vague request with only researchable or defaultable gaps: plan, assume, do not ask (G10, G11).
prompt: Set up CI for my repo at ~/code/atlas.

arguments.goal: Every push and pull request to ~/code/atlas runs lint and tests in CI, and the first run on main is green.

steps.title: Inspect the repo
steps.acceptance: Language, build tool, test command and lint tools listed

steps.title: Write the CI workflow
steps.acceptance: Workflow runs lint and tests on push and pull_request

steps.title: Add lint and format checks
steps.acceptance: Lint and format commands pass locally

steps.title: Make tests run headless
steps.acceptance: The test command passes without a display or network

steps.title: Verify the first run is green
steps.acceptance: The first workflow run on main passes

assumptions: CI provider: GitHub Actions, since the remote is on GitHub
Language and stack: detected from the repo by the inspection stage

reference.content: Plan set: inspect the repo, then write a GitHub Actions workflow with lint and tests, and verify the first run is green. I assumed GitHub Actions and will detect the language from the repo. Starting the inspection.
